description.value: Northern Lights Estate Winery is BC's most northern and largest fruit winery, built on the banks of the Nechako River at the base of Prince George's famous cutbanks. The estate grows gooseberries, raspberries, apples, rhubarb, black currants, cherries, and blueberries on-site, crafting award-winning wines from 100% BC-grown fruit. Visitors can enjoy tours and tastings, a full riverside restaurant (RiverHouse), and the distinction of sipping carbon-neutral, fully vegan wines at a destination unlike any other in northern BC.
